name: Nairobi Business Ventures Plc
source: AfricanFinancials HY2026 summary of Nairobi Business Ventures Plc interim results for the six months ended 30 September 2025, the first half of its financial year ending 31 March 2026. Unit KES. The post tax loss for the period was KES 78.3m against a KES 99.0m loss in the comparative period to September 2024, achieved by cutting administrative and other costs to KES 134.4m from KES 161.0m. Revenue, Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, Profit Before Tax and Income Tax are left empty: the published summary names only the trading division's sales of KES 137.5m, not group revenue, and prints no gross profit, operating expense, pre tax or tax line, so no other row can be placed on the group basis this file uses.
source_note: Absolute Kenya Shillings (Shs). Company (parent) statements. Consolidated group figures are also disclosed (group sales KES 508.0m 2025 / 809.8m 2024) but no consolidated cash flow is published. Other income is nil in 2025. FY2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-nbv-2026-ab-00/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. MAGNITUDE: a period figure that was less than 5 percent of the prior annual column was withheld as unit-suspect; it is blank rather than rescaled.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Gross Profit + Other Income - Administrative Expenses

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: mapped from the printed row "Income Tax (Expense)/Credit" (same figures, panel label)
